title: Orbit and Gravity
author: Beatrix Nystrom
blurb: Coral Zhou, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
